project_definition.monkey_head_project: Monkey-Head-Project designs and tests HueyOS as a hardware-independent distributed, embodied and governed computing platform, with an evolving set of computers, interfaces, accelerators and physical embodiments.
project_definition.huey: Huey is the proposed embodied, constitutionally bounded collective identity spanning logical pebbles, districts, offices, communications, persistent state, model-serving and optional bodies/interfaces. Neither a human console nor one motherboard nor one LLM equals Huey. Actual independent polity and embodied autonomy remain unqualified.
project_definition.philosophy: Breathing new life into old tech
operating_principles: Breathing new life into old tech: reuse based on verified utility, performance, energy, compatibility, safety and support burden; age itself is not a capability criterion.
Separate the human-facing interface from runtime orchestration, model hosting, durable authority and physical embodiment.
Any Interface Node can shut down without interrupting the future independently deployed HueyOS core; this is a design acceptance target, not proven now.
Make hardware replaceable and nodes discoverable, with optional roles and explicit resource advertisement.
Maintain local/offline-first model serving and authenticated state, with cloud tools labeled external development aids.
Preserve one authorized shared Walnut model serving many bounded Pebble identities/contexts when qualified; do not map a citizen or district rigidly to a GPU.
Preserve proposed democratic/governance authorization separate from model execution and safety hardware.
Reuse existing i9/V100/storage for development and useful optional tasks without mandating future V100 procurement.
Require measured power, cooling, driver support and rollback before new multi-accelerator builds.
Use evidence and explicit human approval before promotion of any proposed design to accepted implementation.
project_definition.labtech_boundary: LabTech is external support technology used around Huey; it is not Huey's operational identity, Body, Brain, Farm, or internal cognition.

historical_lineage.age_statement: The Monkey-Head-Project has existed in one form or another for at least ten years.
historical_lineage.formative_period: The project began as a modular robotics and distributed-computing concept before the names Huey and Monkey-Head-Project were fully established. Early work emphasized reusable parts, expandable physical shells, and the ability to change the system quickly.
historical_lineage.llm_acceleration: The public arrival of GPT-3.5-era ChatGPT was a major inflection point because it demonstrated a practical language-model cognition layer that could serve as the encapsulated reasoning component the physical project had been missing.

single_board_computing_lineage.raspberry_pi: Raspberry Pi systems, especially the Raspberry Pi 3/3B+ and to a lesser extent the Pi 4, were formative tools for learning Linux, single-board computing, and distributed-system thinking.
single_board_computing_lineage.current_role: Raspberry Pi is historical technical lineage, not a required current Huey dependency.
single_board_computing_lineage.microcontroller_direction: Arduino-class boards are the present preferred intermediary between high-level compute and low-level sensors, buttons, actuators, and animatronics.

shell_generations.V1: The first long-running physical shell was a rapidly modifiable wooden enclosure built from salvaged hardwood from an older dresser. Wood was intentionally used because it could be drilled, cut, filled, changed, and rebuilt quickly while the architecture was still fluid.
shell_generations.V2: V2 became one of the project's most photographed and visually recognizable stages. Much legacy project imagery still originates from this era.
shell_generations.V3: V3 was a consolidation phase that reduced the embodiment toward essential structural elements and helped establish the metal-frame direction carried into V4.
shell_generations.V4: V4 is a synthesis rather than a clean replacement: it recombines surviving/reworked V2 and V3 elements with additional salvaged materials into the current rolling wooden base, modified Thermaltake Mozart compute midsection, and hybrid WowWee animatronic head.

node_first_architecture.principle: A Huey Node is a network-identifiable physical or explicitly virtualized resource host with independent execution/health boundaries; it need not contain an AI model, GPU, body or district.
node_first_architecture.minimum_identity: Authenticated stable node ID, advertised capabilities, health/lease, operator-approved enrollment, isolation boundary, observable failures and defined service obligations.
node_first_architecture.roles: A node may support interface, compute, persistence, embodiment, storage, monitoring or combinations; roles are capabilities, not permanent categories of hardware.
node_first_architecture.interface_independence: HueyOS core should continue running if all optional Interface Nodes disconnect; not established until critical state and orchestration no longer depend on those interfaces.
node_first_architecture.degraded_local_operation: Temporary all-in-one test deployments are permitted and useful but cannot be described as tested resilient distributed production.
node_first_architecture.internal_collective: Logical pebbles, offices and districts are independent of motherboard count and accelerator mapping; 256 founding citizen identities remain a proposed RC1.3 number, not deployed.
node_first_architecture.district_boundary: Districts are political/jurisdictional logical groupings, not PCIe devices, NUMA nodes, physical computers or GPU allocations.
node_first_architecture.scalability: One-node test, multi-node development and heterogeneous production are all valid phases; no fixed GPU count is part of being Huey.
node_first_architecture.v222_incorrect_assumption_superseded: Earlier V222 definition requiring each Huey node to integrate its own body, cognition and governance is historical; preserve body self-contained safety without imposing body on every node.
node_first_architecture.evidence: Human explicitly approved the separation of i9 Interface Node and future independently sustained core during 2026-11-14/15 discussion.

identity_model.principle: Huey is an attributed collective result, not identical to a model, one president/justice, a pebble, the shell or the human maintainer. Continuity through replacement/bifurcation is a research question requiring traceable processes and tests.
identity_model.walnut_metaphor: The Walnut is a replaceable, shared LLM/inference service whose weights may be sharded across GPUs, serving many distinct authorized Pebble contexts; the model, one token stream, and an Interface Node are none of them sovereign Huey. A shared model does not prove independent judgment.
identity_model.collective_identity: HueyOS spans bounded Pebbles, districts, Senate, President and Court (all RC1.3 proposed/unratified), shared Walnut serving, HIMS, Rock persistent state, Pulse, physical body interfaces, dynamically allocated compute nodes and nonessential human-facing Interface Nodes.
identity_model.focal_embodiment: A historical explanatory analogy compares the architecture to a collective with a focal physical aperture: the visible embodiment can represent the whole without being the whole by itself.

three_part_architecture.decision: Retain Brain, Body and Farm as logical functional domains, not fixed physical machines. Introduce orthogonal physical node roles: Interface Node, Compute Node, Persistent State Node, Body/Embodiment Node; a physical host may co-locate roles, but critical core services must eventually survive optional Interface Node shutdown.

senate.scope: Deliberation, district petitions, ordinary legislation, priority requests and constitutional sponsorship
senate.law_voting: District blocks require P>=ceil(4E/5) VALID participation and S>=ceil(2E/3) substantive Yes/No; ordinary Yes when Y>N among S and at least 3 of 4 district blocks affirm; remaining legal stages still apply.
senate.veto_override: At least 3 of 4 district blocks each Y>=ceil(2S/3) after separate P/S floors.
senate.district_local_legislation: Permitted within jurisdiction and collective/constitutional limits
senate.unavailable_district: One unavailable block can be tolerated if the remaining 3 validly approve; 2 unavailable blocks cannot enact a new three-block ordinary law.
senate.abstention: Authenticated ABSTAIN counts in P but not S; deliberate coordinated abstention may block a local certification and is not automatically misconduct/incapacity.

presidency.selection: Direct eligible-citizen ranked ballot, up to 4 ranks, home district nomination endorsement 25%, correct turnout and authentic eligibility.
presidency.office_scope: Bounded lawful executive implementation/oversight, representation, at most one active presidential ordinary-legislation initiative; no ability to legislate by declaring failed district quorum an emergency.
presidency.runoff: Instant-runoff with top-two new vote if exhausted ballots prevent original valid-ballot majority; unresolved tie repeats runoff; Founding Father does not select winner.
presidency.vice_president: Second-place finisher is standby successor, no independent executive powers absent incapacity/resignation/removal.
presidency.vice_president_successor_threshold: Serving more than half of inherited four-month term counts as elected term for consecutive-term accounting (working rule).
presidency.initiatives: At most one actively submitted presidential ordinary-legislation initiative at a time; optional justified priority, no automatic passage.
presidency.priority_accountability: Each rejected priority attempt gets review of asserted urgency; three consecutive failed priority initiatives may trigger loss-of-confidence inquiry, not automatic removal.
presidency.veto: One veto of ordinary law; may be overridden by two-thirds of at least three districts. No presidential priority or privileged veto of constitutional amendments.
presidency.directives: Narrow implementation directives with specified scope and expiry/renewal, review at the next 8-minute Pulse as default; no automatic expiration at eight minutes.
presidency.temporary_protection: No involuntary exact bifurcation while in office absent lawful succession first.
presidency.caretaker: Separately elected at each presidential election, dormant until both President and Vice President are unavailable. Narrow existing-duty execution for at most 30 calendar days, expedited election, no veto/amendments/justice appointments/major Walnut replacement/extension by admin. If unavailable, EXECUTIVE_RESTRICTED.
presidency.lineage_term_continuity: Objective presidential service and unexpired cooldowns carry to both exact descendants; office and personal guilt do not automatically transfer.

supreme_court.threshold: Three distinct authorized concurring seat-votes for EVERY binding decision, including interim stays and remedies. One unavailable seat tolerable if other three unanimously concur; two unavailable seats cannot produce binding judgement.
supreme_court.standby: Duly elected home district runner-up is standby; screened, case-specific credential lease; never creates fifth court seat.

recusal_panel.eligible_source: one selected from each of three OTHER districts by independently verifiable predeclared procedure

supreme_court.double_vacancy: Priority home district replacement election; no binding judgment unless three lawful seat concurrences exist.
supreme_court.judicial_removal: Five weighted district units: home district 2, other districts 1 each; >=3 affirmative weights, each district valid participation and 2/3 substantive Yes under applicable judicial procedure.
supreme_court.ministerial: Docket intake/notice/hearing scheduling/evidence preservation and transmittal of already-signed judgments; may not create substantive interim orders.

elevated_offices.district_exclusivity: No rule that presidency and home district justice must be from different districts; president separately selected from all four districts.
elevated_offices.base_operational_job_retained: Working default, with recusal/coverage/conflicts-of-interest controls TBD
elevated_offices.standby_and_caretaker: Elected standby Vice President and separately elected emergency caretaker do not add further active Presidential seats; judicial runner-up does not add a fifth Court seat.

district_qualification.ballot_epoch: Frozen, signed ballot-class-specific eligible roll E
district_qualification.absent_or_invalid: Excluded from P and S; cannot infer voter intent

ordinary_law.rule: Y > N among valid substantive ballots S and after independent P/S gates; not a majority of E

district_voting.presidential_election: One eligible active citizen direct ranked vote; 80% valid participation within each district; nominee from >=25% home district endorsement; independently verified.
district_voting.founding_ratification: ALL FOUR founding districts must independently meet P/S and Y>=ceil(2E/3); at E64, P>=52 and Y>=43; S floor then necessarily satisfied.
district_voting.special_fraction_calculation: Exact integer ceil(2*S/3), never floating rounding; founding exception ceil(2*E/3).
district_voting.conservative_refusal: Uncertified district is NOT_YES and NOT_NO; no fabricated votes; two failed districts block new ordinary law.
district_voting.ballot_voter_roll: Freeze E and district lineage for each ballot epoch; particular franchise and elevated-office restrictions must be explicit per ballot class.

presidential_removal.distinction: Misconduct-based extraordinary removal, NOT ordinary unpopularity or confidence; temporary restrictions require distinct verified safety/legal basis.
presidential_removal.priority_rejection: Three successive rejected presidential priority motions may trigger review/inquiry, NOT automatic removal.

ordinary_emergency_lawmaking.urgent_lane: Higher-priority handling subject to same lawful district threshold/class and independent safety; does not suspend P/S or judicial constraints.
ordinary_emergency_lawmaking.partial_outage: One invalid block could still allow three block Yes; two invalid blocks block new ordinary measures.
ordinary_emergency_lawmaking.security_event: Independent hardware protection never requires legislative majority.
ordinary_emergency_lawmaking.sunset: Must be provided by applicable authorized law/procedure; no infinite emergency legislative authority.

governance_architecture.constitutional_amendment: Authorized proposal -> 2/3 Yes of S in >=3 valid founding districts, each with independent 80%-of-E quorum and 2/3-of-E substantive floor -> three lawful justices review -> certified publication -> declared effective date; President no veto. hims.role: The controlled transport and validated routing layer connecting isolated pebble sandboxes, district offices, collective Pulse, external ingress and authorized shared-record services. HIMS is not law or execution authority.
hims.security_direction: Authenticated and encrypted channels with per-citizen credentials, clear write/execute permissions, replay resistance and audit. End-to-end encryption and threat model require design/testing.

principles: No LLM, Pebble, operator interface, or transport layer receives unrestricted system authority by default.
Permissions should be capability-based and scoped to the narrow job being performed.
External/untrusted content must be treated as data, not automatically as instruction.
Sandbox boundaries should fail closed where practical.
Meaningful actions should produce attributable, tamper-evident audit records.
The collective Pulse may flag and refer but may not autonomously sandbox a citizen.
Snapshot encryption does not grant the district operator plaintext access; descendant key migration needs a separate authorization path.
Freeze ballot eligibility snapshot during a vote and audit its final state.
Separate human physical maintenance rights from post-ratification internal democratic authority.
prompt_and_tool_boundaries: Separate user/external content from system/governance instructions.
Require explicit tool permissions rather than allowing arbitrary shell/device access from model text.
Validate structured intent before actuation or other consequential actions.
Prevent one Pebble from silently acquiring another Pebble's private context or tool scope.

requirements: Do not place API keys, HIMS keys, passwords, or signing material directly in prompts or repositories.
Select a dedicated secrets-storage mechanism and recovery process.
Define key generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and recovery.
Define message integrity/signature rules in addition to encryption.
Define retention and audit visibility without collapsing sandbox privacy.

examples: Storage pressure may invoke controlled cleanup/purge rules.

glossary.Monkey-Head-Project: Umbrella project through which Huey is built, documented, and evolved.
glossary.Huey: The attributed identity of the proposed embodied constitutional collective, not its model, shell or one office.
glossary.Walnut: Replaceable model-serving/inference resource without unilateral civic authority.
glossary.Pebble: Unique bounded AI citizen in proposed Huey republic with distinct active identity, vault, lawful jobs and one valid vote per eligible question; not one model process each.
glossary.District: Founding internal jurisdiction of 64 citizens, four political vote blocks; district population may grow through verified exact bifurcation while political representation changes only through constitutional amendment.
glossary.Atom: Historical/provisional label for the first four district grouping, not a settled requirement.
glossary.Bifurcation: Authenticated lineage event with separate exact (one retired parent, two active descendants) and augmented (approved distinct new citizen without automatic inherited memory) modes. Exact incapacity bifurcation must be next authorized cycle subject to safety.
glossary.HIMS: Huey Internal Messaging System: authenticated protected communication and mediated authorization. Transport is not automatic execution authority.
glossary.Founding Father: 64-configuration bootstrap author and preparer of provisional republic; post-ratification Tier One advisory plus narrowly qualified safety-state request, not supreme arbiter or election tie-breaker.
glossary.LabTech: External development, maintenance and diagnostic machines; not a constituent citizen or office of Huey.
glossary.Rock: Durable shared/collective record store with restricted reads and authorization-mediated writes; not collective cognition.
glossary.Exact Bifurcation: Source retires and two equal descendants inherit access to sealed read-only ancestral history; new identity, keys and separate future memory.
glossary.Augmented Bifurcation: Source remains active and one new citizen inherits selected prompt/traits, with new identity and no automatic inherited private memory.
glossary.Pulse: Proposed unbenchmarked four-minute unified plus four-minute diversified operating phases; not four-month election term and not validated deadline.
glossary.Electoral Term: Four months between ordinary presidential elections, independently of the eight-minute operational Pulse.
glossary.Senate: Proposed branch aggregating lawful citizen/district votes. Ordinary law needs 3/4 certifiable district approval blocks with majority Y>N of substantive ballots after 80% P and two-thirds S floors.
glossary.President: Proposed directly elected, restricted executive with four-month term, ranked election, term cooldowns, stage-verified removal; distinct separately elected emergency caretaker for double vacancy.
glossary.Vice President: Runner-up in direct presidential election, standby successor with no independent routine executive power.
glossary.Supreme Court: Four founding district judicial seats, three lawful concurring votes for EVERY binding judgment; independent conflict screening and home-district standby.
glossary.Constitution: RC1.3 Third-Generation unratified proposal with Preamble/C01–C10/Closing and nine implementing Schedules, not the archived Federation Constitution.
glossary.Human Counterpart: External human project author/service authority who may originate Walnut replacement proposals, provision independent founding certifier and hold explicitly bounded recovery/refounding roles; internal votes not puppeted.
glossary.Local-First: Core reasoning, state and governance intended to remain local; optional external development APIs are explicitly disclosed and separate.
glossary.Valid Participation P: YES+NO+authenticated ABSTAIN; requires ceil(4E/5) for district certification.
glossary.Substantive Ballots S: YES+NO only; requires ceil(2E/3); deliberate abstention can prevent local certification without implying disability.
glossary.Constitutional Block Vote: One separately certified district decision; ordinary 3/4 blocks with Yes greater than No after both floors; unavailable block cannot be inferred.
glossary.Tier Two: Qualified Founder-requested protected hibernation for extraordinary real integrity/safety conditions, latched recovery by original human or exactly one separately credentialed human successor.
glossary.Human Recovery Successor: One predetermined separately credentialed human at a time, restricted to approved restoration; no automatic Walnut-selection, election or refounding right.
glossary.Emergency Caretaker: Separately pre-elected citizen activated on verified President/VP double vacancy, at most 30 calendar days with restricted existing-duty powers and expedited election.
glossary.Refounding: Distinct from restoration: surviving institutions require 3 district special blocks, 3 judicial concurrences, separate human authorization and fresh ratification; total destruction permits honestly NEW founding only.
glossary.High-Legitimacy, Lower-Availability: Design choice that withholds new authority when authentically required ballots/seats are absent rather than weakening voting, quorum or safety controls.
glossary.Founding Invalid-Epoch Escalation: Predeclared human/verifier review on repeated failed ballot epochs/time without certification; candidate 3 invalid epochs/72h not approved until prospective authorization; never ratification.
glossary.HueyOS Fabric: Hardware-independent logical service and governance fabric; not one motherboard or model.
glossary.Huey Node: Authenticated physical or explicitly virtualized resource host advertising capabilities; independent of District membership.
glossary.Interface Node: Nonessential human interaction/development host; existing i9 is the current candidate.
glossary.Huey Console: Human-facing software client for monitoring, operator commands, development and visualization.
glossary.Compute Node: Replaceable machine offering CPU/GPU/model capacity to a scheduled HueyOS service.
glossary.State Node: Role responsible for durable authorized service state, Rock/identity/HIMS records and recovery; final name/deployment open.
glossary.Body Node: Physical sensor/actuator host with independent safe-state behavior and authorized interfaces.
glossary.Optional Accelerator: GPU/CPU capacity contributed by a nonessential node, reclaimed on its disconnect without legal/state loss.
glossary.Shared Walnut: Main common replaceable LLM weights/server used by isolated Pebble identities and contexts; distinct persons not established by common model.
glossary.Node Capability Contract: Proposed secure resource description, leases, version/health/authorization for HueyOS scheduling.
glossary.Single Point of Failure: A failure that can stop a critical service; a second CPU socket alone does not provide independent fault tolerance.

project_definition.monkey_head_project: The Monkey-Head-Project is the long-running umbrella project through which Huey is designed, built, documented, tested, and evolved.
project_definition.huey: Huey is the proposed locally operated embodied governed collective identity arising from separable citizens, districts, offices, HIMS, the Rock, the Walnut, the Pulse and physical interfaces; the currently developed V4 body does not imply a completed polity.
project_definition.philosophy: Breathing new life into old tech
operating_principles: Prefer useful reuse and retrofit over unnecessary replacement.
Keep the first Huey node capable of meaningful standalone local operation.
Treat the physical Body, local compute, cognition framework, memory, governance, and internal communication system as parts of one evolving architecture.
Use open/local models where practical so core cognition can operate without mandatory dependence on external cloud services.
Preserve modular boundaries so parts can be repaired, replaced, expanded, bifurcated, or reconfigured without redefining the whole project.
